body.value: One row, one figure: 16 — how many of Contoso's physical shops have stopped trading, each counted once as premises, over the entire record with no region and no period restriction. Every one of the 16 is a shop that stood on a site for a single trading period and carries a closing date; the closures fall between 2013-12-05 and 2019-11-03, and nothing has closed since. NOT INCLUDED: the 57 shops still trading, the web shop (no closing date, and not a physical shop), and any account of why or when each closed — a count carries neither. INCLUDED, and worth saying: 7 of the 16 are marked 'Restructured', so the premises closed but the site was rebuilt and has a shop open on it today; the shop is gone, the location is not.

WITH p AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM contoso_served.dim_store
  WHERE
    location_code <> -1
), closed AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM p
  WHERE
    NOT close_date IS NULL
), live_sites AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    location_code
  FROM p
  WHERE
    close_date IS NULL
)
SELECT
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM closed
  ) AS closed_premises,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT location_code)
    FROM closed
  ) AS sites_with_a_closed_premises,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT location_code)
    FROM closed
    WHERE
      NOT location_code IN (
        SELECT
          location_code
        FROM live_sites
      )
  ) AS sites_with_nothing_trading_now,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT location_code)
    FROM closed
    WHERE
      location_code IN (
        SELECT
          location_code
        FROM live_sites
      )
  ) AS closed_sites_retenanted_and_trading,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM closed
    WHERE
      status_annotation = 'Closed'
  ) AS shut_premises,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM closed
    WHERE
      status_annotation = 'Restructured'
  ) AS restructured_premises,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT location_code)
    FROM closed
    WHERE
      status_annotation = 'Closed'
      AND NOT location_code IN (
        SELECT
          location_code
        FROM live_sites
      )
  ) AS shut_sites_nothing_trading,
  (
    SELECT
      MIN(close_date)
    FROM closed
  ) AS first_closure,
  (
    SELECT
      MAX(close_date)
    FROM closed
  ) AS last_closure
